summary: Extends the general Open Pluggable Edge Services (OPES) mechanisms, such as tracing, bypass, and callouts, so they work for HTTP traffic. Together with the generic OPES documents, this profile forms a complete specification for adapting HTTP messages using services at the network edge. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Sometimes a helper in the middle of the road changes a parcel on its way, like adding a stamp. This memo explains how such helpers can safely work on web traffic.
